newsitem.title: UK: Sakura Bank unit sets $1.0 bln debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Sakura Bank unit sets $1.0 bln debt issue.

text.p: Sakura Capital Funding Ltd, guaranteed by Sakura Bank, has launched a $1.0 billion two-tranche subordinated perpetual debt issue, sole lead manager Merrill Lynch said on Wednesday.
The deal will consist of a floating-rate note and a fixed-rate bond. The size of each and the pricing will be set on Thursday.
Indicated pricing for the FRN is three-month Libor plus 95 basis points until February 2002, after which it will step up to 245 b.p. over.
The fixed tranche was likely to be priced to yield 120 b.p. over five-year U.S. Treasury notes. In February 2002 the coupon would step up to six-month Libor plus 245 b.p. if the deal was not called.
The expected subordinated rating is Baa2 from Moody's Investors Service and BBB from Standard & Poor's.
